summary: Champaner is a historical city in Gujarat, western India, located in Panchmahal district about 47 kilometres from Vadodara. The note states that the city was briefly the capital of the Sultanate of Gujarat. It also notes the city was formerly known as Muhammadpur and gives its name in Gujarati script as ચાંપાનેર.
one_line: Champaner is a historical city in Panchmahal district, Gujarat, India, once briefly the capital of the Sultanate of Gujarat.
key_facts: Champaner is a historical city in the state of Gujarat, in western India.
Champaner is also written in Gujarati script as ચાંપાનેર.
Champaner was formerly known as Muhammadpur.
Champaner is located in Panchmahal district, Gujarat.
Champaner is 47 kilometres from the city of Vadodara.
Champaner was briefly the capital of the Sultanate of Gujarat.
